about_the_game:
Introducing a new fantasy character asset pack from REFMAP!

This collection includes walking character sprites along with corresponding side-view battlers.

Vol. 3 features characters inspired by a desert kingdom.

Try combining them with Vol. 1, Vol. 2, and the default assets for even more variety!

*******************************************

Characters: 53

Main characters: 8 + 4 arranged versions (12 bodies with collapsing motion)

Occupations: 11 + 1 arranged versions (11 collapsing motions, 1 special motions — 12 variations total)

Townspeople: 8 (8 collapsing motions)

Animals: 6 characters + 2 mounted versions (6 with collapse animations)

SV: 18 types

　Main characters: 8

　Occupations: 8 types + 4 arranged version

*******************************************

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
